title: Owner choices (H1, H2, H3)
description: choices.json in the state directory (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.3: H1, H2 and H3 answers with UTC times; v1.1 adds the optional canvas_url, type_release and published_at of the review canvas to H1 and H2, Q-F11). In mode A the orchestrator writes each answer from the decision or manual task (FE-04, FE-06, FE-21) after reading it through Notion or Remote Control; in mode B /frontend writes it from AskUserQuestion. Comments on a Claude Design canvas are not answers, so no such channel exists here. A key is absent until its checkpoint is answered.

H1.description: Direction picked from {state}/directions/<A|B|C>/, or none with the owner's reason (DR-12). A none answer is valid here but leaves FE-04's proof failing, so a new round of directions follows.

reason.description: Why the owner rejected every direction; required when pick is none.

H3.description: Sign-off of the deployed preview at recording size, after /harden's review and before any recording.

changes.description: Numbered changes the owner asked for; empty when signed off.

url.description: The preview that was signed off.

change.description: At most one sentence of change; empty when none.

by.description: owner, or the developer id (devA, devB) who relayed the owner's answer.

source.description: Where the answer is recorded, for example .execution/answers/T005.md or the Notion row.

canvas_url.description: v1.1 (Q-F11): the private review canvas the owner looked at for this checkpoint (a Claude Design artifact the orchestrator published), so the answer can be traced to what was shown. Optional; absent with review_surface board or terminal.

type_release.description: v1.1 (Q-F11): the release of the artifact type the canvas was made from (for example 1790818940-93cf), so a later re-read knows which canvas format it holds.

published_at.description: v1.1 (Q-F11): UTC time the canvas was published for the owner; before answered_at.
